visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video features a split-screen layout. The top half displays 3D animated scenes from a video game (NieR:Automata) showing two blindfolded characters, a female with short white hair and a male with blonde hair, sitting in a desolate, ruined urban environment under a hazy sky. The bottom half shows a real-life female pianist with extremely long silver-white hair, seen from behind. She wears a black leather outfit and long opera gloves, playing a black Steinway grand piano in a studio-like setting with blue curtains. (2) The animated portion transitions through several close-up shots of the characters' faces and glowing black cubic objects they hold. Meanwhile, the pianist's hands are shown in a medium shot, moving with precision and fluidity across the keyboard. The lighting in the bottom half is bright and cool-toned, while the top half uses a warmer, desaturated cinematic palette. (3) The scene shifts to a brighter indoor animated setting with white walls and blue curtains that mirror the real-world background. The characters stand and interact, while the pianist continues her performance with increasing physical movement of her arms and torso. Occasional shots in the top half show mechanical flight suits and combat-ready poses. (4) The animation becomes more intense with rapid cuts showing character combat, explosions, and dramatic facial expressions. The pianist's playing reflects this intensity, with more aggressive hand movements. The video concludes with final animated shots of the characters in battle and a close-up of a character's emotional face, while the pianist finishes the musical phrase.
